financial_pl.actions.sendToKsefConfirm: Sending to KSeF is irreversible. Click "Send to KSeF" again to confirm.
financial_pl.errors.advance_data_require: An advance invoice (ZAL) requires the order (Zamowienie) data. Set the order snapshot before submitting it to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.alreadySubmitted: This invoice is already submitted to KSeF and cannot be sent again.
financial_pl.errors.already_accepted: This invoice was already accepted by KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.buyer_required: This invoice has no buyer details. Add the buyer to the invoice before submitting it to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.certificate_auth_req: A KSeF certificate credential is required to enroll a new certificate. Obtain the first certificate via the Ministry of Finance taxpayer app (qualified signature).
financial_pl.errors.correction_lines_req: This credit memo has no lines, so the correction amounts cannot be derived. Add the corrected lines before submitting it to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.correction_reason_re: A KSeF correction requires a reason. Set the credit memo reason before submitting it to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.credentials_missing: KSeF credentials are not configured for this organization.
financial_pl.errors.credit_memo_not_link: This credit memo is not linked to an invoice, so the corrected invoice cannot be referenced in KSeF. Link it to the original invoice first.
financial_pl.errors.currency_unsupported: Only PLN invoices can be submitted to KSeF yet. Foreign-currency invoices are not supported.
financial_pl.errors.document_type_unsupp: Only standard VAT invoices can be submitted from an invoice. Corrections are submitted from a credit memo; advance and final invoices are not supported.
financial_pl.errors.exchange_rate_requir: A foreign-currency invoice with domestic-rate (Polish) lines requires a resolvable exchange rate to compute the PLN-converted VAT (P_14_xW). Set the exchange rate before submitting it to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.invoice_not_issued: Only an issued (immutable) invoice can be submitted to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.issue_date_required: Invoice issue date is required before it can be submitted to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.meta_save_failed: Failed to save the Polish VAT metadata.
financial_pl.errors.offline_certificate_: The Offline KSeF certificate is expired or not yet valid.
An Offline KSeF certificate must be enrolled before issuing an invoice offline.
financial_pl.errors.offline_mode_invalid: The offline mode and the failure-end timestamp are inconsistent: awaryjny requires it, offline24 must omit it.
financial_pl.errors.offline_send_overdue: This offline-issued invoice is past its statutory send-to-KSeF deadline.
financial_pl.errors.original_issue_date_: The original invoice has no issue date, so the correction cannot reference it in KSeF. Set the original invoice issue date first.
financial_pl.errors.original_ksef_number: The original invoice has no KSeF number and is not marked as issued outside KSeF. Submit the original to KSeF first, or confirm it was issued outside KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.original_not_accepte: The original invoice has not been accepted by KSeF yet. Wait until it has a KSeF number before issuing a correction.
financial_pl.errors.oss_country_required: An OSS (WSTO_EE) invoice requires the consumption-country code. Set the OSS destination country before submitting it to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.oss_rate_required: An OSS (WSTO_EE) line requires a destination-country VAT rate. Set the consumption-country rate (or a known EU member state) before submitting it to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.precorrection_amount: A correction of an advance or settlement invoice (KOR_ZAL/KOR_ROZ) requires the pre-correction payment amount (P_15ZK). Set it before submitting it to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.proformaNotEligible: Pro forma invoices cannot be sent to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.proforma_not_support: A proforma invoice cannot be submitted to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.seller_required: The KSeF seller details are not configured. Set the seller name and address on the KSeF integration before submitting.
financial_pl.errors.sendFailed: Failed to send the invoice to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.settlement_refs_requ: A settlement invoice (ROZ) requires references to the prior advance invoices it nets. Set the advance references before submitting it to KSeF.
financial_pl.errors.upr_threshold_exceed: A simplified invoice (UPR) total must not exceed 450 PLN (or 100 EUR). Issue a full invoice instead.
financial_pl.errors.vat_rate_unsupported: This invoice uses a VAT rate that cannot be mapped to a KSeF FA(3) field. Use a standard Polish VAT rate.
